title: Basic Needs of Living Things
seo_title: Primary 1 Basic Science: Basic Needs of Living Things Worksheets (NERDC)
standard_code: Primary 1 Basic Science: Living and Non-Living Things
standard_text: Living things need food, water, air, sunlight and shelter to survive. Plants make their own food using sunlight; animals eat plants or other animals. Living things depend on their surroundings, and people care for them. (summary of the Basic Science curriculum, Primary 1, theme: Living and Non-Living Things)
meta_desc: Free Primary 1 Basic Science worksheets (NERDC curriculum, theme: Living and Non-Living Things): needs of animals, needs of plants, food for living things, homes and caring for living things. 100 questions with answers.
key_big: All living things need water, air and food.
key_sub: Plants also need sunlight to make food.
body_html:
How to think about it

Animals need food, water, air and shelter. Plants need water, air, sunlight and soil (nutrients). Without these needs, living things cannot grow or stay alive.

Plants make their own food using sunlight. Animals get food by eating plants or other animals. A habitat, such as a pond or a forest, gives living things what they need.

Example

What does a plant need to make food?

Light, water and air

Answer: sunlight, water and air (carbon dioxide)

Example

Why does a fish need water?

It takes oxygen from the water.

Answer: it gets oxygen and lives in water

Common mistakes

  • Thinking plants eat soil.
  • Thinking animals do not need water if they eat food.
  • Thinking plants do not need air.
